mode.title: Mode
mode.description: gas = one row per chain with fee levels, congestion and the cost of four standard actions. actions = one row per chain per action, ranked cheapest first. history = recent blocks with base fee and how full they were.
enumTitles: Gas levels and costs per chain

chains.title: Chains
chains.description: ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc. Empty returns all six.

actions.title: Transaction types
actions.description: transfer (send the native coin), token_transfer (send an ERC20), swap (trade on a DEX), nft_mint. Gas units are representative of each kind of transaction, not a quote for a specific one.

blockCount.title: How many blocks
blockCount.description: History mode. Recent blocks per chain, up to 10 per request from the node.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
